text:
nina: starting Shoreline AI RFI thread. they want a POC for semantic search + embeddings, must show on-prem option, KMS/HSM, SSO via SAML, and 99th pctl latency targets. delivery window: 3 weeks. who can take lead on matrix and security answers?

rob: I can do the capability matrix. need QPS and average input length. any analytics on expected hits per query?

nina: their spreadsheet says 60 peak embed qps, 15 sustained, avg tokens 8, long searches up to 512 tokens for context. security questionnaire attached in drive: https://drive.redwood/shoreline/rfi_security_questions.pdf

kevin: 60 qps embedding is fine for Hosted with caching. For Private/on-prem we'll recommend 2x L4s or 1x H100 depending on latency SLOs. POC plan: start hosted w/ dedicated pool, move to Private for data residency check.

rob: pricing ask: they want a monthly estimate for both Hosted (managed) and Private (one-time infra + monthly support). I'll draft numbers but need ops uplift for Private (1x SE for onboarding).

lia: security answers: SOC2 type II in prod, encryption at rest AES-256, TLS1.2+ in transit, support for customer-managed KMS and FIPS 140-2 HSM via Private. I'll prepare short-form answers.

rfi-bot: uploaded: https://files.redwood/cap-matrix/shoreline_rfi_matrix_draft.csv

rob: quick asks to include in matrix: 1) explicit latency rows for embeddings at 8 and 512 tokens (99th pctl), 2) function/tool-calling support in Private, 3) export control note.

kevin: latency numbers to use (est): "Embeddings 8 tokens: 99th pctl 60ms (Hosted cached), 120ms (Private baseline)" and "Embeddings 512 tokens: 99th pctl 180ms (Hosted cached), 420ms (Private baseline)". add note that KV caching improves often by ~30-40%.

lia: function calls: Private supports tool callbacks via our local agents bridge and outbound webhook config. link: https://docs.redwood/private-tooling. include note: customers must whitelist outbound endpoints.

nina: legal question: can we commit to a POC SLA for latency? they asked for contractual 99th pctl guarantee during POC.

kevin: we should not sign SLA for POC. proposed language: "POC: we provide performance targets as guidance; contractual SLAs available upon Dedicated/Private contract and monitoring integration."

rob: Security Q item 12 asks about data retention and raw payloads. Lia, suggested phrasing?

lia: Hosted: request metadata retained 30 days; payloads optionally retained if customer opts in; default redaction applies. Private: customer controls retention and may enable full logging. Add a note about compliance: FedRAMP/IL/ISO requests require engagement.

nina: edge case: they want HSM to be provisioned in less than 2 weeks. is that possible?

kevin: typical lead time for FIPS/HSM provisioning in Private is 3-4 weeks depending on vendor and procurement. we'll add: "HSM available for Private; estimated provisioning 3+ weeks."

rob: draft matrix now includes two pricing lines: Hosted monthly est $8k/mo (with caching/auto-scale) and Private one-time infra ~$45k (hardware + deployment) + $6k/mo support. mark as rough.

lia: also add SSO/SAML support and SCIM for user sync. include sample SAML metadata doc link.

nina: please attach a short test curl for embeddings with retry header for their engineers to smoke test.

rob: adding snippet in the CSV notes:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -H "Retry-After: 2" \
  -d '{"model":"r-embed-1","input":"example text"}'
```

kevin: also note idempotency header for batch ingestion.

nina: final blockers before I assemble final RFI bundle: confirm export control language and procurement lead time acceptance. Rob, can you share final CSV by EOD?

rob: will push final CSV by 16:00 PT. ping me if legal flags anything.

lia: I'll draft the security responses and upload as PDF.

nina: great team. we'll send the RFI bundle to Shoreline procurement Fri morning. thanks :rocket:
